## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies SC3 (happy-path E2E), SC13 (direct-mode regression), and SC15 (thread-resolution) by executing the live GitHub E2E.

## Implementation

Run merge-to-main.sh with merge.strategy=pr (already set in .claude/dso-config.conf). This creates a PR, queues auto-merge, polls CI, resolves threads, and merges to main.

Expected: PR created, CI passes, branch merged, script exits 0.

Verify: git log origin/main showing the merge commit.

SC15 (direct-mode regression): verified by the merge-to-main-direct.sh extraction tests that passed earlier.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] merge-to-main.sh exits 0
- [ ] git log origin/main shows merge commit from this worktree branch
  Verify: git log origin/main --oneline -5 | grep -q worktree-20260503

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 1 (live GitHub E2E — no retries)
data.title: Run merge-to-main.sh --strategy=pr E2E and capture in-session trace (SC3/SC13/SC15)
